steps: Do this once (Google's setup screens changed in 2026 — this matches the current flow):
2. At the top of the page, click 'Select a project'.
4. In the search bar, find 'Google Drive API' and click 'Enable'.
5. Go to APIs & Services > Google Auth Platform, and click 'Get Started'.
6. Enter an app name and your email as the support email, then continue.
8. Enter your email again as the contact email, check the agreement box, and continue/create.
9. Go to the 'Data Access' tab, click 'Add or Remove Scopes', find and add the '.../auth/drive.file' scope, then save.
10. Go to the 'Audience' tab, add yourself under 'Test users', and save.
11. Go to the 'Clients' tab, click 'Create Client', choose 'Desktop app', name it, and create.
12. Download the JSON shown after creation (the client secret is only shown once).
13. Open the downloaded JSON file in TextEdit or Notepad and paste its full contents here.
